title: Scale-safe reranking: regional priority throttles, circuit stratification, and KV prefetch policy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background:
The reranking endpoint has been a hotspot under regional traffic spikes. Current behavior exposes downstream model capacity to bursty traffic resulting in P99 tail latency regressions and occasional model OOMs in secondary regions. We need a composite approach addressing admission control, regional affinity, and lightweight local fallbacks while preserving quality for high-SLA customers.

Goals:
- Prevent cross-region overload by enforcing regional priority throttles per customer tier and model family.
- Introduce stratified circuit-breakers (fast vs sustained) per model variant and region to reduce cascade failures.
- Implement a KV prefetch policy for embeddings/rerank pipeline to reduce cold-cache tail latency for frequently-seen prefixes.
- Provide safe rollout and observability (per-tenant P99, circuit state, throttled requests, fallback ratios).

Technical approach:
1) Regional priority throttles:
   - Maintain token-bucket lanes per (region, customer_tier, model_family). High-SLA customers get separate lane with dedicated burst tokens.
   - Admission points: routing-tier (edge) enforces soft tokens and credits; serving edge enforces hard rejects.
   - Config: rate, burst, refill, and spillover policy (optional spill to compatible cheaper model).

2) Circuit stratification:
   - Fast circuit: trip on short, high-rate errors (e.g., 50% 1s-window failure) and open for short cooldown (sensitive to error spike).
   - Sustained circuit: trips on longer-term degradation (e.g., 10% over 5m) and triggers longer fallback and backlog shedding.
   - Circuits tracked per (region, model_variant, tenant_prefix). State exposed via Console and used in routing decisions.

3) KV prefetch policy:
   - Heuristic-based prefetch for top-K prefixes per tenant derived from recent traffic. Prefetch warmups executed in CPU layer before forwarding to model.
   - Budgeted prefetch limits per region to avoid creating new burst loads. Prefetch backed by admission tokens.

4) Fallback policy and quality tiering:
   - Define fallback chains (primary model -> quantized variant -> cached-similarity reranker -> degraded scoring with static-sort).
   - Fallbacks constrained by customer tier and time budget. Metrics recorded for quality regressions.

Monitoring & SLOs:
- Dashboard: per-tenant P50/P95/P99 latency, circuit open rate, throttle hits, fallback ratio, prefetch hit rate.
- Alerting: sustained P99 > baseline + 250ms for a customer tier triggers pager and auto-rollbar.
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in cross-region error cascades during spike tests; P99 latency improvement on cold-prefixes by 25%.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0: feature flags, simulation mode in staging (no rejects, only metrics).
- Phase 1: enable throttles as soft (queue/re-prioritize) in canary region with a subset of tenants.
- Phase 2: enable hard rejects and circuit stratification for low-risk model families.
- Phase 3: KV prefetch enabled with strict budget, expand to other regions.
- Phase 4: full rollout with monitoring and automatic fallback policies.

Acceptance criteria:
- Unit/integration tests for token-bucket behavior and circuit transitions.
- Load test that simulates simultaneous spikes across 3 regions showing reduced cross-region failovers.
- Dashboards populated and owner-signed.
- Postmortem plan in place for rollbacks.

Trade-offs considered:
- Prefetch vs extra load: limited prefetch budget to avoid worsening bursts.
- Per-tenant lanes increase config complexity but give strong isolation for high-value customers.
- More aggressive circuits reduce availability for some tenants during transient errors; we prefer fast circuits with short cool-downs to avoid unnecessary long outages.

Open questions:
- What default spillover model variants should be allowed across regions? (Ops input)
- How to best surface tenant-level cost/latency trade-offs in Console for product/CS?

comments: 2026-03-02 - PM review by Jordan Lee: Strong +1 on per-tenant isolation. Requested a clear rollback plan and customer opt-outs.
2026-03-04 - Design review by Priya Nair: Suggested fast/sustained circuit names and recommended exposing circuit metrics at tenant granularity. Added sketch to Confluence.

2026-03-07 - Engineering note by Miguel Santos: Implemented token-bucket prototype in staging; observed correct burst shaping but prefetch created unexpected extra RPCs. Added budget cap and queued a follow-up test.
2026-03-09 - Ops comment by Elena Rossi: Confirmed infra can tag model variants for cross-region spillovers. Ops requests a list of allowed fallbacks per region for compliance checks.
2026-03-11 - QA update by Chen Wu: Integration tests for circuit transitions added. Found race when circuits flip during in-flight KV warmups; creating subtask ENG-83548 to harden handoff.
2026-03-12 - Security review by Maria Gomez: No direct data exposure but asked to document prefetch cache TTL and KMS usage for cached vectors.
